prompt.name: Archer
prompt.look: An ancient-to-medieval archer: a lean young man with a short dark beard, a brown leather hood, a knee-length tunic with a brown leather belt, bare forearms with a leather bracer on the left forearm, brown leather boots to mid-calf, a quiver of arrows on his back and a plain wooden longbow.
prompt.identity: the same face and beard, hood, red tunic, belt, bracer, boots, quiver and bow
prompt.weapon_pose: He holds the bow upright in his left hand in front of his body, its lower tip ending above his knees; his right hand hangs at his side. No arrow is nocked.
prompt.attack: (1) ready, bow held low; (2) he draws an arrow from the quiver; (3) he nocks it and raises the bow, aiming right; (4) full draw, the string pulled back to his cheek, the arrow pointing right; (5) release: the string has snapped forward and the arrow is gone (do not draw it in flight), his drawing hand flies back; (6) recover, lowering the bow.
prompt.damage_gear: a cracked bow and a few broken arrows in the quiver
prompt.damage_gear_critical: a split bow limb bound with cord and an almost empty quiver
prompt.defeat_prop: leaning on the bow planted on the ground

states.note: walk built in code from the master and from each damage drawing; the legs alternate by construction
